actions.action: Expire records strictly and return explicit outage errors.
actions.mechanism: A fixed deadline prevents reads or source failures from extending a record’s freshness.
actions.implementation: Set monotonic expiry to insertion time plus 300 seconds, shortened by any source expiry. Delete expired entries before lookup; return 503 with source_timeout when retrieval times out.
actions.check: With a fake clock and stalled source, verify the expiry-boundary request returns 503 and removes the record.
actions.risk: Strict expiry sacrifices availability during source outages.

actions.action: Enforce capacity with reserved slots and LRU eviction.
actions.mechanism: Atomic slot accounting bounds retained records, including refresh candidates, while eviction prioritizes expired entries.
actions.implementation: Use 100 slots. Reserve a slot before materializing a fetched record; evict expired entries, then least-recently-used entries. Release reservations on timeout; never extend existing expiry.
actions.check: Run concurrent requests for 150 keys during intermittent timeouts; assert occupied plus reserved slots never exceeds 100.
actions.risk: Reservations can evict useful records before unsuccessful fetches.

actions.action: Coalesce retrievals and bound source waiting.
actions.mechanism: One retrieval per key prevents duplicate refreshes; a circuit breaker suppresses repeated calls during an outage.
actions.implementation: Share in-flight requests by key with a two-second deadline. After five consecutive failures, open the breaker for ten seconds, then permit one probe. Serve only unexpired hits; otherwise return 503.
actions.check: Issue 50 same-key misses against a stalled source: verify one call, bounded waits, and no expired response.
actions.risk: Breaker thresholds may reject requests during brief recoveries.

actions.action: Admit only explicitly approved public record fields.
actions.mechanism: A public-only upstream projection prevents unnecessary or private fields from entering the cache.
actions.implementation: Request an allowlisted public schema from a public-only source endpoint. Validate before insertion; reject unexpected fields without logging payloads. Return 502 for rejected responses and release reserved slots.
actions.check: Inject an unexpected sensitive field; verify rejection, no cache insertion, reservation release, and no payload in logs.
actions.risk: Field allowlists cannot detect private values inside approved fields.
